problem: University students struggle to form study groups
goals: Match students based on course, availability, and study style

user_stories.i_want: To easily find and join study groups
user_stories.so_that: I can improve my academic performance
acceptance_criteria: The app displays a list of available study groups
The app allows users to filter study groups by course and availability
The app sends notifications when a study group is formed

user_stories.i_want: To be matched with study groups that fit my study style
acceptance_criteria: The app asks users about their study style preferences
The app matches users with study groups that fit their preferences
The app allows users to adjust their study style preferences

user_stories.i_want: To easily manage my study group
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure the group runs smoothly
acceptance_criteria: The app allows leaders to add and remove members
The app sends notifications to leaders when members join or leave
The app provides tools for leaders to schedule meetings
The app is user-friendly and easy to navigate
The app is secure and protects user data
The app is accessible on multiple devices

risks.description: Difficulty in developing a robust course matching algorithm
Insufficient user adoption due to lack of paid APIs
